Text: Mijin Gakure in 30 seconds!
Mijin Gakure in 20 seconds!
Greetings and good-bye.
Are you alive?
Are you happy?
Let us rise above death!
We require aether.
Do not be afraid. Death is not the end.
I will show you the worlds beyond.
Deploying drones.
Are you still alive? Activating reserve power.
Are you still alive? Disengaging safeties.
Target area delineated. Commencing erasure.
System overload. Aborting process.
Are you still alive? Recommencing erasure.
System overload. An error has occurred.
System override order confirmed.
5 seconds to Absolute Authority...
4 seconds to Absolute Authority...
3 seconds to Absolute Authority...

IF tHIngS shoULd...turN...wORSe... MiGHt...aID...
I-I will SHow you...tH-tH-tHe woRLds beyoND...
Are yOu-are yoU-are YOu...are you hapPY?
Do...DO-do-do not be a-Be AFraID...
Let...let uS...let us...let uS...above deaTH...
Drown in true Darkness!
Darkness as my blade!
Nothingness rules over all!
My clouds shall smother Light!
Darkest Darkness awaits!
Begone with you!
I will exterminate you like the vermin you are!
Both Darkness and Light in my hands...
All shall know oblivion's sweet embrace...
Death is but a prelude to nothingness...
Winds of Darkness, usher all unto oblivion!
Death abide in my breast!
Wind abide in my breast!
The Darkness...will not be contained!
Become silent stone!
You shall not escape!
I'm the only one fit to protect her...
Come! Show me your strength!
Only I can protect her!
Fools... You would stoke the fires of conflict?
The Light shall usher in peace!
Come to me, Hraesvelgr!
I shall weave a new Dragonsong!
I told you it would make a great necklace.
Ohhh...it's beautiful! I think it'll really suit you!
Me? But I thought you should have it...
Is this ice? Where did this come from?
O Chaotic Dark, descend and quench Light!
Past...present...future.
Infinite possibilities...condensed into a single moment!
Pain shall be fleeting, joy everlasting...
As I wish it, so shall the river of time flow!
Still you resist. Then we shall unleash the Light within!
No! I won't let you!
Aaaaaahhh!
Ryne!
She won't last much longer!
Yaaaaaargh!
Hold on, Ryne!
Ryne, are you alright!?
I am thanks to you, Gaia.
You're Mitron! Ugh... Aaaaaahhh!
I am Loghrif, servant of Zodiark.
I shall restore the power of Darkness to this star.
Her awakening is incomplete... Their memories weaken the link.
Such impediments to our resonance must be expunged.
The time is come. Together, we shall rejoin the Darkness!
We shall bring eternal harmony.
Tranquility and vitality in perfect balance...
No one will erase our promise. No one!
This cacophony... My head...
So close to realizing our perfect utopia...
I'll never stop. As many times as it takes!
When next I return, I will succeed!
Begone from my memories! Every last trace of you!
We're not going to disappear!
Aye, we're too stubborn for that!
We'll get through this, Ryne!
Yes, together!
Our friend won't fail us!
You'd better not, or I'll never let you hear the end of it!
We won't give up on the future!
Please, let our prayers be heard!
If this place cannot be our utopia...
Then naught in existence holds meaning!
That's a little melodramatic, don't you think!?
You can weather this! I know you can!
Yaaaaaargh!
Our promise fades...
Light and Darkness, gather to me!
You endure? Another approach, then...
I am yours, and you are mine!
What is this!?
I won't let you do as you please!
What is this!?
Ryne... Are you there?
Gaia?
Raaaaaargggh!
Let's begin, shall we?
Can the challenger defeat the wolf in his own lair!?
I wonder if you can keep up...
Such speed─it's as if there's a pack of him!
Can you fend off a pack of wolves?
I do like toying with my prey.
Fenrir's power can be wielded in surprising ways.
Where did that colossal thing come from!?
He's put the colossus to the sword!
Not bad, not bad. But we've scarcely begun.
Bear my biting winds!
Still you stand... How delightful!
With Fenrir's might, I rouse a storm!
This has gone on long enough. Victory is mine!
No, I will not lose... I need more power!
Fenrir's unbound might!
No matter what becomes of my body...defeat is not an option!
Something's amiss... What does he intend to do!?
Egads! The ring's been destroyed, and they've fallen below!

They've moved to floating deathtraps!
How will they fight with so little room?
Now I fight with everything I have! Prepare yourself!
I will rend all asunder!
You'll have nowhere to stand!
He's destroyed an isle! It'll take time to restore it!
The power of wind unleashed!
You cannot escape from the wolf!
I will draw upon my all to defeat you!
Even if it costs me my life...
Neither side is holding back, but there can be only one champion!
I will prevail!
You're strong, I admit... But I'm the one who will win!
Dodge this if you can!
Will you be able to stay on your feet?
Defeat the Howling Blade
Aaarrrgh!
Have at you!
To take it outside, the Brute Abombinator means business!
Will the unenhanced warrior be able to contend with this chimerical foe!?
My word! He's used his feral powers to manifest a weapon!
Oh dear, fiendish flora have sprouted from the scattered seeds!
Oh my! Even the cameras have been petrified─and now they're crashing down all around!
He's sent his rival flying! What fearsome strength!
Goodness me! The Brute Abombinator is hanging on the building!
He's bounding from wall to wall!
The rooftop has caved in! Such devastation!
We'll send cameras in there at once!
The destruction appears to have started a fire!
A lariat! The Brute Bomber must still be in there somewhere!
A punishing attack! The true power of this monstrous fusion!
The contender dodged everything! Why am I not surprised!?
A brutal blow! But the contender is standing firm!
What a thrilling battle this, and it rages on!
Defeat the Brute Abombinator
This machine has long guarded these crumbling halls.
Let us introduce more weaponry.
So be it. We proceed to the next phase.
Perhaps a new approach to assess your adaptability.
Were you to die here, it would save me trouble later.
Still alive. How unfortunate.
I'm beginning to understand how you were able to defeat Queen Eternal.
Let us see what this yields.
How will you handle this?
I am the soldier S0, of Alexandria's castle-guard. By order of the royal knights, I shall dispatch all intruders.
Releasing limiters... Initiating mobile combat maneuvers.
Calling reinforcements. Together we shall triumph.
Combat functions...inoperable... Forgive my failure...
Clear the foundation sector
Defeat the gargant
Clear the royal radius
Defeat the soldier S0
Clear the retrolevel
Defeat the Valia Pira
There are beasts ahead of you. They must have gotten in and made themselves at home.
The direct route is inaccessible. You'll have to go around.
There should be an access hatch nearby that leads inside. Look for an opening.
I'm detecting something big... You'll have to deal with it to continue on.
Good work. Now, proceed to the access hatch and head inside.
Everkeep's construction was apparently a constant battle against the rising water level.
Even during the war, the people labored to maintain the castle. It meant a lot to them.
It's upsetting to think that Preservation's terminal is in this place...
Hold on... Someone's jam...mmunications! Stay alert!
So you have come. Let us measure your strength.
That was hardly a challenge, I see.
You will show me more. I bid you press on.
You are untroubled thus far, but I have something that may test you yet.
What inspiration will you give me, I wonder!
Welcome to Sugar Riot's gallery of glamours!
Perhaps I'll draw...this!
And with a flourish, Sugar Riot brings her work to life!
When you can't decide on one thing...
An image comes to me! I hope you like it hot and sandy!
Goodness, the ring has become a desert!
How about a little more sunshine?
When I think desert, I think of these prickly fellows!
Watch out, it's a veritable storm of needles!
There's something missing... Oh, I know!
Quicksand!? You don't want to get caught in that!
Oh no! The challenger's been sucked in!
What do you say to a refreshing riverscape?
A crystal-clear river! How charming!
This is no good! It needs a touch of thunder, a dash of downpour!
A thunderstorm has turned the waters muddy! How frightening!
I have it! Some destruction to facilitate deconstruction!
A massive, raging storm! I hope you brought your parasols!
You've sparked my imagination! The ideas fairly erupt!
Lava is ravaging the ring! Talk about destructive creativity!
Pudding alone gets awfully dull, don't you think?
A transformative piece! The fiend has been completely remade!
What's your favorite color?
What do you think of this?
Needs more impact!
You've reminded me of something truly important: art must be free!
Defeat Sugar Riot
Upon my blade I swear, no harm shall come to Her Highness!
You will not defile Zelenia's memory any longer!
Try this!
No quarter!
Vermin!
Taste my steel!
Have at you!
Fall!
Rain down!
Burst!
Pierce!
Feel the sting of my divine blade!
Rage and roil!
I know this technique... You must keep moving!
Heavens roar!
That her bladework should be recreated so faithfully...
Have care! Zelenia was capable of much, much more!
Power fill my blade!
I will show you the soul of a royal knight!
For the honor and glory of Alexandria, I strike!
This is her deadliest technique...but you must endure!
Behold the essence of my art!
You've no time even to fear my wrath!
There is no escape!
Surge!
Quickly, away from the sigils!
The sigils channel magic! Be on your guard!
You must brace for blade and magic both!
Amazing... You withstood Zelenia's bladework!
You must take care when avoiding the sigils!
I have pledged my life to the kingdom!
My resolve shall never waver!
You're no match for me!
Ignorant fools.
No more games!
I will suffer none to threaten Alexandria!
I am sworn to protect my queen! I will die before I yield!
That's right... Zelenia was always there to protect me...
I know this is merely a reconstruction...and yet...
For the honor and glory of Alexandria, I strike!
Defeat Dancing Green
Are you ready to get down?
The upstart's cruiserweight campaign begins!
Can you keep up with the rhythm?
Dancing Green is pulling out all the stops with these steps!
We're just getting started! Keep groovin', baby!
On the dance floor, everyone's a star!
Bask in the spotlight and burn, baby, burn!
An invitation to dance! How will the challenger respond?
C'mon, show me your moves!
You're up, dancers!
Let's turn up the heat! Try to keep up, now!
The fever's taken hold! Can the upstart keep up with Dancing Green?
Dance like there's no tomorrow!
Let's finish with style!
You're burnin' up the dance floor, baby!
Groovy moves! The crowd's lovin' it!
Not bad, but I reckon you've got more in you!
Hey, what're you tryin' to do, put the crowd to sleep?
Back to it, dancers!
Yeah, baby! I feel the fever comin' on again!
The night's reached a fever pitch! All eyes are on Dancing Green!
Show us some electrifying moves!
Dancers, take it away!
Let's bring the night to a scorchin' close!
That was one helluva party! Let's do it again sometime!

Clear Horlais Peak
Clear armada airship
Clear Qufim

Clear the Celestial Nexus
Chateau d'Oraguille...? Is this meant to be San d'Oria?
Ronfaure is supposed to be a quiet place that sees its fair share of new adventurers...
A burning circle, here? It would appear the land has been altered...
This is Horlais Peak... We must be ready for anything.
It seems we've impressed Kirin! Let us keep up the good work!
The Jeuno Armada. But what is there to gain from recreating this battle?
It's Ultima and Omega! And they're attacking those airships!
Ultima and Omega are on a rampage... Who unleashed them?
I do not see an easy way back... But I'm sure you can handle things without me!
At this rate, everything will be laid to waste...

しばらく合流は難しそうだ……！
すまないが、そいつらを止めてくれ！
...But it would appear I've landed on the wrong airship.
An impressive show. Hurry, now─do not keep me waiting.
You shall find me at the summit.
Farewell, my little brother. Return to the crystal from which you were born.
You have the privilege of walking within the heart of Tu'Lia. Do not disappoint me.
Come, then. Show me what your kind can do.
Behold the glory of the Zilart.
You are naught but insects to be crushed.
O Sublime Estoc, drink deep of the elements!
Once more, shall we?
Careful, now. The face of war is ever-changing!
Kneel before Zilartian wisdom and die.
This is the power of crystals. Transcendent. Sublime!
By their might, I pave the path to Paradise!
I am the will of the crystal!

さらばだ、道化の猿どもよ。
おまえたちの役目は終わった、世界の終わりが始まるのだ。
That you should still stand... Very well, then!
I thank you for this amusement!
Wh-Why? I am the will...of the crystal... How could I be defeated by mere mortals...?
As for the rest of you, I invite you to the Gate of the Gods.
You, who have risen above your mortal status... I am Kirin.
Kirin could never be summoned here. More meddling from that fiend Sareel Ja, no doubt.
I must thank you, mortals...
O guardians divine, lend me now your might!
O Suzaku, conjure your infernal flames!
O Seiryu, scatter blood upon the wind!
O Byakko, rend with fang and claw!
O Genbu, entomb in rock and earth!
The divine beasts? Have care!
This surging power, I bring to bear!
This is no power I've seen before... But I won't be daunted!
試練を与える。
頭を垂れよ。
Render up yourselves in tribute!
You shall reap the rewards for daring to contend with the gods!
There is no escape!
Hah, nary a scratch! Well done!
A comrade is in trouble! Someone heal them!
A comrade is down! Someone revive them!
A truly mighty blow! The adventurers of your world are extraordinary indeed!
Such potent healing! My thanks!
Such adamant defense... Our unbreakable resolve made manifest!
I fear I cannot shield against this assault alone. Shields, with me!
This world shall belong to the Zilart.
All pales before our brilliance!
Can you escape this, I wonder.
Allow me to show you a trick I've learned!
Even in this false flesh, I will not lose to you!
You fought well, but it's time to say good-bye.
This is not Vana'diel. I'm well aware of that.
I also understand the true nature of my existence. So come, let us finish this.
I will eliminate you and make this world ours!
The time for games is over. Behold my true power!
I shall forge a more fitting stage for our battle.
I do so hope you'll live up to my expectations.
Loath as I am to employ medicines in the application of harm, I will protect my patients.
Activate dispensers!

A potent concoction, this one.
...I am sorry, but you must be stopped.

Defeat the Immortal Remains
Ah, you've come. I'll begin by wearing you down.
I've created new Endless for you. Not all are warriors, but they will follow orders.
“Kill” and “survive” and so forth. Here, I shall prepare the stage for battle.
The memories of a physician. One who saves lives should be reluctant to die.
Oh, you've overburdened the system. No matter. It served its purpose.
Next, we visit a prison of sinister repute. I need not compel them to fight.
These are loyal executioners. They shall deal appropriately with “criminals.”
Beginning to tire? Good. I bid you continue on.
Memories from an age rife with death... The desperation will serve well.
The enemy is at the gate. To arms, good soldiers─protect your kingdom.
An amalgam of memories. Let us see how it fares.
It is the midst of the Storm Surge.
Countless lives are lost in the senseless conflict.
The war swells in scope and intensity.
The bombs rain down without pause or mercy.
The spark of life is dimmed with every blinding flash.
Death is everywhere, pillaging the promise of the future.
Your sentence is death. How long can you defy it?
Criminals may run, but they cannot escape.
Water... Light... Need...!
Sprout, sprout... Sprout, sprout...!
Bloooooom... Every blossom bloooooom...!
Water... Light... Wither not...!
Sprout more! More sprouts!
Your precious Light shall feed my vengeance...
Purgatory to cleanse your sin.
Shackles of flame, bind my foe!
Light rend you asunder!
Rise from the abyss, O mighty flame.
Pale aberration...prove your worth.
I shall bathe in your blood.
Offer your soul, your suffering...
Burn upon my wrath.
Know your punishment!
Ruination to mortal flesh!
Wither and die...
A curse of Light consume you.
Fire from within, come forth!
You are finished... The abyss take you!
Thank you for agreeing to help decorate the cakes, kupo!
'Tis a simple matter of carrying the ingredients from the shelves around the room to the central cake stands.
There is, of course, the matter of the mammet pâtissiers. Should they spot you, use the whistle to temporarily disable them!
First up: one <sheet(ValentionSweetsRecipe,IntegerParameter(1),0)>, if you please!
Ready, steady...decorate!
Once you have an ingredient in hand, bring it to the cake stand in the center, kupo!
Take care to avoid the mammet pâtissiers!
All that remains is to decorate the cake!
The <sheet(ValentionSweetsRecipe,IntegerParameter(1),0)> is halfway to completion!
The <sheet(ValentionSweetsRecipe,IntegerParameter(1),0)> is almost complete!
The ingredients are on shelves around the room! Fetch the ingredients in the recipe, kupo!
Collect the required ingredients and decorations to add the finishing touches to as many cakes as you can.
The mammets are moving more quickly. Take care, kupo!
Kupopo! Watch out─the mammets seem even madder than before!
The <sheet(ValentionSweetsRecipe,IntegerParameter(1),0)> is complete! And what a fine cake it looks!
Next, let us see if we can create a <sheet(ValentionSweetsRecipe,IntegerParameter(1),0)>!
It's the final cake! Let your inspiration guide you!
Choose the frosting, decorations, and cake toppers that make your heart sing!
I believe we're out of time, kupo!
But we haven't much time, kupo... Make haste!
I believe we're out of time, kupo!
The final cake is decorated splendidly, kupo!

Thank you for your wonderful help, kupo! I can hardly wait to complete our delivery...
Everyone has their off days─do not take it to heart!
To think you'd decorate five whole cakes... You have proven yourself the master of confection and affection alike, kupo!
Four cakes is quite something. You have a knack for cake decorating, kupo!
Three cakes, kupo! This should be a feast!
Two cakes─this makes you a fully fledged pâtissier, kupo!
This cake shall more than suffice. As long as you put your heart into it, you've captured the spirit of Valentione's Day, kupo!
Our guests will be most delighted. Let us return to the festivities posthaste!
The ingredients you need are no doubt twinkling with anticipation, kupo!

Rescue the citizens

Best make sure the evacuation route is clear first...
Done! Now to aid those people by the canal...
Help is on the way!
There may be other stragglers...
That breeze is awfully warm... Oh no!
First things first─the fire!
Not a moment too soon... I hope that was the worst of it.
A voice...further out!
Somebody, help!
I'll take care of this─make for shelter!
How many are there...?
Thunderheads...
Keep away from the clouds!
If I never see another storm...
Nowhere is safe with so many of them...
Some friendly winds, if you please!
It worked!
Grrroooaaar!
The levin grows more volatile... Something is coming.
Ball lightning!
Y'shtola, Sphene─lend me your strength!
The two of us will disperse these balls of lightning!
Take cover behind the spriggan!
The tide is turning. Press the attack!
H-Heeelp!
Our home...
I can still fight! I can!
I have no doubt!
How fortunate that bird made such an impression.
Just keep the lightning at bay a little longer!
You are bound by the limits of flesh. It will betray you.
Fear compounds fear, eroding your strength.
Do you not see? Death is upon you...
Drag them to their graves.
You will die for me now.
Accepting death is the greatest sin a life can commit.
Those who do not resist death deserve it.
Still alive. But there are ways to change that.
You struggle in vain.
Fight if you must.
I will reduce you to aether.
I am prepared for you.
Fall to ruin.
Once the terror takes root, it will only continue to grow.
The endless darkness engulfs you...
...Why do you persist?
And here it ends for you.
Mankind must evolve.
Kill them.
Perhaps this.
Bothersome.
There.
Shining sacks collected
